description.en: Enhances graphics and adds extra visual effects.

label.en: Compare with the game's own look

description.en: The layer of dust that drifts across the picture on most planets.
Restores the fine detail that anti-aliasing softens, with less at strong edges so they don't ring. Takes effect at the next launch.
Deepens the dark tones and spreads a soft glow around lit areas, in place of the game's bloom. The HUD keeps the game's colors. Takes effect at the next launch.
Ambient light in daytime missions on desert planets. Off by default, as the bright sand makes the picture too bright with it. Applies at once.
Darkens the light where surfaces meet, such as at the foot of walls and under crates and rocks.
Ambient light darkens only the light from the sky, so the effect shows mostly in shade. All daylight darkens sunlight too.
The size of the sun's shadow map; larger gives sharper shadows. 8192 uses 256 MB of video memory. Takes effect at the next launch.
How far from the camera the sun casts shadows. The game stops at about 20 m, which can leave the top of the screen without shadows when zoomed out. Takes effect at the next launch.
Softens the hard, stepped edges of sun shadows. Takes effect at the next launch.
Draws the scene above the screen's resolution and scales it down, for cleaner edges. 2x costs about four times the pixel work. Takes effect at the next launch.
How far from the camera models keep their most detailed version.
